children: Shares of Enviro Infra Engineers rose nearly 10 per cent to a nearly one-month high of Rs 215 on Wednesday after the company said its step-down subsidiary, Suyog Urja, secured a Rs 190-crore engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) turnkey contract from Tata Power Renewable Energy.
The contract is for a 180-MW NTPC wind power project in Parli, Maharashtra.

The project includes the supply of reinforcement steel, geotechnical work and balance of plant operations, comprising a fully equipped 39-acre storage yard, logistics coordination, and construction of site roads, pathways and crane pads.
It also includes work on a 33-kV transmission line.
The positive sentiment was also seen in shares of other companies in the sector.
Shares of VA Tech Wabag rose nearly 7 per cent to Rs 2,143.90 apiece, while Denta Water and Infra Solutions gained 2 per cent to Rs 284.45 per share.

title: Enviro Infra shares rise up to 10% on fresh order; VA Tech Wabag, Denta Water shares see rub-off effect
